topic: How the block subsidy shrank over time
hook: The Bitcoin block reward started at fifty and keeps shrinking.

scenes.narration: The subsidy began at fifty bitcoin. It then dropped to twenty-five, twelve and a half, six and a quarter, and three point one two five.
The most recent halving was at block eight hundred forty thousand, in April 2024.
Miners still earn the subsidy plus transaction fees. But the subsidy part keeps shrinking.

cta: Which halving do you remember? Tell me in the comments, and the link is on my channel page.
title: Bitcoin Block Reward: 50 BTC to 3.125 BTC
description_body: How the subsidy stepped down from 50 to 3.125 BTC across four halvings.
